O.outcome_detail: Explaining measurement and phase kickback

cells.quote: All the interviewed students confidently explained that the results from measuring qubits are always in the form of zeros and ones with some probability values; it cannot be in a superposition state (Fig. 2).

cells.quote: The students were very confident and comfortable using matrix operations for almost all the questions (Fig. 3 shows a student using matrix method in a calculation). cells.note: The comparison reflects reported student strengths versus difficulties with alternative representations.
